tool_snapshot.name: qd4_update_case
tool_snapshot.description: Updates the Case record for this call with the outcome, request details, the deterministic summary and the KPI metrics in one write. v4 only.
tool_snapshot.dslContent:
qd4_update_case(caseId: string, sessionId: string, outcome: string, caseType: string, serviceReason?: string, transferReasonCode?: string, transferReason?: string, stepReached: string, endedAt?: string, accountNumber?: string, buildingNumber?: string, practiceName?: string, callerName?: string, jobTitle?: string, telephony?: object, firstRequest?: object, requests?: array, summary?: string, metrics?: object) -> object
  description: "Updates the Case record for this call with the outcome, request details, the deterministic summary and the KPI metrics in one write. v4 only."
  type: http
  params:
    caseId:
      description: "The Case record id returned at creation."
    sessionId:
      description: "The platform session id of the call."
    outcome:
      description: "IN_PROGRESS, DELIVERED, PENDING_SCHEDULED, TRANSFERRED, ABANDONED or ENDED_NO_ACTION."
    caseType:
      description: "in_progress, delivered, pending, transfer, abandoned or no_action."
    serviceReason:
      description: "Fax, Email, Pending or Not Found."
    transferReasonCode:
      description: "The internal transfer reason code, when transferred."
    transferReason:
      description: "Short fixed reason text with no patient data."
    stepReached:
      description: "The flow step id reached when the Case was written."
    endedAt:
      description: "Call end time, ISO 8601 UTC, when terminal."
    accountNumber:
      description: "The authenticated 8-digit account number."
    buildingNumber:
      description: "The account location building number."
    practiceName:
      description: "The practice name from the account record."
    callerName:
      description: "The caller's first and last name."
    jobTitle:
      description: "The caller's job title as said."
    telephony:
      description: "callerAni, five9CallId and, in simulate mode, debugHeaders the hub would send."
    firstRequest:
      description: "patientName, patientDob, testName, accession, deliveryChannel, deliveryDestination (masked) and resultStatus of the first request."
    requests:
      description: "One entry per patient handled, same shape as firstRequest."
    summary:
      description: "The deterministic 3C summary text."
    metrics:
      description: "stageReached, outcome, reasonCode, reasonClass, dataAvailable, modelTurns, apiLatencyMs, durationSec (no PHI)."
  endpoint: "{{env.QD_API_BASE_URL}}/cases/{{caseId}}"
  method: PUT
  idempotency_header: Idempotency-Key
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json

tool_snapshot.name: qd_create_case
tool_snapshot.description: Creates the write-ahead Case record for this call with outcome IN_PROGRESS. Returns the record with its id, which the flow keeps as case_id.
tool_snapshot.dslContent:
qd_create_case(sessionId: string, outcome: string, caseType: string, serviceType: string, stepReached: string, startedAt: string, accountNumber?: string, buildingNumber?: string, practiceName?: string, telephony?: object, summary?: string) -> object
  description: "Creates the write-ahead Case record for this call with outcome IN_PROGRESS. Returns the record with its id, which the flow keeps as case_id."
  type: http
  params:
    sessionId:
      description: "The platform session id of the call."
    outcome:
      description: "IN_PROGRESS at creation."
    caseType:
      description: "in_progress at creation."
    serviceType:
      description: "Always Results."
    stepReached:
      description: "The flow step id reached when the Case was written."
    startedAt:
      description: "Call start time, ISO 8601 UTC."
    accountNumber:
      description: "The authenticated 8-digit account number."
    buildingNumber:
      description: "The account location building number."
    practiceName:
      description: "The practice name from the account record."
    telephony:
      description: "callerAni and five9CallId when the channel provided them."
    summary:
      description: "The deterministic 3C summary text."
  endpoint: "{{env.QD_API_BASE_URL}}/cases"
  method: POST
  idempotency_header: Idempotency-Key
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  timeout: 4000

workflow_description_at_publish: v4: builds the Case body with the deterministic summary and KPI metrics (qd_build_case) and writes it in the same call: PUT /cases/{caseId}, a missing or unknown id falls through to POST /cases. Returns status, caseId, outcome, requests.
